name: igv-report
description: Build, inspect and edit self-contained IGV.js genome-browser reports (igv-reports HTML pages with an inlined region table and one session per locus). Covers the create_report build, the track-config JSON that the defaults get wrong, a lossless decode/patch script for editing a report when the source data is not on this machine, and the standing long-read isoform-comparison track recipe.
